title: Presentation
description: Purposeful readable slides under declared viewing conditions.
guidance: Do not solve every overflow by reducing type size.
Prefer authorized splitting and hierarchy changes while preserving source data.
Record unavailable projection and target-application checks explicitly.
No detector or rendering pass is implied by selecting a rule.
Select design rules by actual purpose, brand constraints and readable access; a motif alone is not a verdict.
Require a pre-production contract and current attributable authorization; verify bounded exception records separately.
Strict comparison of repeated structures is an explicit review policy; do not infer a universal ban on three cards or gradients.
